description: Racket READER-fidelity corpus for run_reader_fidelity.py. Ground truth is Racket's own reader (reader_oracle.rkt), which only READS: no module is instantiated, so any file the local install can read is a legitimate target, scripts included.

pinning.policy: Both trees ship with the Racket toolchain and are pinned by the Racket VERSION; reader_results.json records the version it was measured against.

targets.stresses: The whole default-reader surface as real code uses it: here strings, `#rx`, `|sym bol|`, `#cs`, infix dots, every `#` dispatch, CRLF files. The control group for at-exp -- `@` is an ordinary symbol constituent here and must stay one.

Every `#lang at-exp` .rkt in the full distribution: text bodies with nested forms, `@|...|` escapes, `@;` comments, alternate delimiters, and `@` inside identifiers and strings that must NOT dispatch.
